dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the exact value asserted for both the infimum and the norm of an optimal perturbation.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any natural dimensions m,n, real m-by-n matrix A, and b in R^m, define c(A,b)=0 if b=0, and c(A,b)=||A^T b||_2/||b||_2 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.name: Claimed optimal perturbation size

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With y=0 and δb=0, requires the zero vector to minimize the least-squares objective for A+ΔA and the unchanged right-hand side b.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any m,n, A in R^(m×n), b in R^m, y in R^n, ΔA in R^(m×n), and δb in R^m, P(A,b,y,ΔA,δb) means that y is a global least-squares minimizer for the matrix A+ΔA and right-hand side b+δb. Both additions are entrywise.
dependency_coverage.name: Perturbed least-squares feasibility

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes the perturbation measure as the absolute Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every real m-by-n matrix A, define ||A||_F=sqrt(Σ_i Σ_j A_ij^2), with indices i in Fin m and j in Fin n.
dependency_coverage.name: Frobenius norm

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target evaluates this quantity at y=0 and identifies it with c(A,b).
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any m,n,A,b,y of the indicated dimensions, define β(A,b,y) as the real infimum of S(A,b,y), the set of Frobenius norms of matrix perturbations making y a least-squares minimizer while leaving b fixed.
dependency_coverage.name: Infimal matrix perturbation size

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes feasibility a global minimization condition over every competitor in R^n.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any m,n,A,b and x in R^n, x is a least-squares minimizer precisely when, for every z in R^n, Q(A,b,x)≤Q(A,b,z).
dependency_coverage.name: Global least-squares minimizer

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the squared quantity underlying the Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any real m-by-n matrix A, return Σ_{i in Fin m} Σ_{j in Fin n} A_ij^2.
dependency_coverage.name: Sum of squared matrix entries

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the precise feasible norm set whose infimum appears in the target; only the matrix is perturbed.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any m,n,A,b,y, S(A,b,y)={η in R : there exists ΔA in R^(m×n) such that P(A,b,y,ΔA,0) and η=||ΔA||_F}.
dependency_coverage.name: Attainable perturbation norms

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the vector in the numerator of c(A,b).
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any m,n,A,b, return the vector A^T b in R^n whose j-th coordinate is Σ_{i in Fin m} A_ij b_i.
dependency_coverage.name: Transpose matrix-vector product

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies Euclidean norms in both numerator and denominator of c(A,b).
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every natural n and vector x in R^n, define ||x||_2=sqrt(Σ_{i in Fin n} x_i^2).
dependency_coverage.name: Euclidean vector norm

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies the exact objective used in all minimization predicates.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any m,n,A,b and x in R^n, define Q(A,b,x)=Σ_{i in Fin m} ((Ax)_i-b_i)^2=||Ax-b||_2^2.
dependency_coverage.name: Squared residual objective

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Underlies both the Euclidean norm and the least-squares objective.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every natural n and x in R^n, return Σ_{i in Fin n} x_i^2.
dependency_coverage.name: Sum of squared vector coordinates

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes the residual used to define least-squares minimization.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any m,n,A,b,x, return the vector r(A,b,x) in R^m with r_i=(Ax)_i-b_i.
dependency_coverage.name: Residual vector

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies ordinary finite-dimensional matrix action in the objective.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any m,n, A in R^(m×n), and x in R^n, return Ax in R^m with (Ax)_i=Σ_{j in Fin n} A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.name: Matrix-vector product

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires the infimum identity and witness existence simultaneously, and requires every listed property of that witness.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For propositions a and b, And(a,b) is their conjunction: both a and b hold.
dependency_coverage.name: Logical conjunction

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses exact scalar equalities, vector equality to zero, and equality between a feasible set element and a perturbation norm.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type or sort α and any x,y in α, Eq(x,y) asserts that x and y are equal.
dependency_coverage.name: Equality

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Quantifies the optimal matrix perturbation and the matrix witnesses defining attainable norm values.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type or sort α and predicate p on α, Exists(p) asserts that some x in α satisfies p(x).
dependency_coverage.name: Existential quantification

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the row and column index sets and permits zero-dimensional matrices and vectors.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each natural n, Fin n is the finite type of natural indices 0 through n−1; Fin 0 is empty.
dependency_coverage.name: Finite coordinate index type

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses n≤m, least-squares objective comparisons, and the optimal perturbation norm inequality.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type α equipped with a relation LE, this projection returns its binary relation ≤ on α.
dependency_coverage.name: Less-than-or-equal relation projection

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes dimensions nonnegative integers and supplies natural exponents.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Nat is the type of natural numbers including zero.
dependency_coverage.name: Natural numbers

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the numeral 0 in real and vector types and the exponent 2 as a natural number.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type α, natural number k, and an OfNat α k instance, return the element of α designated by the numeral k.
dependency_coverage.name: Numeral interpretation

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes each vector written as 0 identically zero in every coordinate.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any index type ι and family of types M(i), each equipped with a zero, the dependent function space has zero given by the function i↦0 in M(i).
dependency_coverage.name: Pointwise zero function

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, vector coordinates, objectives, norms, infima, and optimal values are real.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.name: Real scalar domain

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures objective and norm comparisons use the ordinary real order.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the usual relation ≤ on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.name: Real order instance

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies scalar zero and the coordinate values of every zero vector.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the real number zero as the distinguished zero element of R.
dependency_coverage.name: Real zero instance

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects written zero numerals to the real and pointwise vector zeros.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type α with a distinguished zero, interprets the numeral 0 as that zero.
dependency_coverage.name: Zero numeral instance

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the dimension hypothesis the usual natural-number inequality n≤m.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies the ordinary less-than-or-equal relation on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.name: Natural-number order instance

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Exposes the real division operation used in c(A,b).
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type G equipped with a division-and-inverse monoid structure, extracts its division operation.
dependency_coverage.name: Division structure projection

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Allows exhaustive sums over all row and column indices and finite-coordinate equality decisions.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every natural n, supplies an enumeration of Fin n by 0,…,n−1, with no repetitions and containing every element.
dependency_coverage.name: Finite enumeration of coordinates

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the logical decision of whether the finite real vector b equals zero for the conditional defining c(A,b).
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any finite type α and family β(a) with decidable equality in every fiber, gives decidable equality of dependent functions f,g by checking f(a)=g(a) for all a in the finite enumeration.
dependency_coverage.name: Equality decision for finite functions

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applies addition to entries when forming the perturbed matrix and right-hand side.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For types α,β,γ with a heterogeneous addition operation α×β→γ, extracts that operation.
dependency_coverage.name: Addition operation projection

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the norm ratio in the nonzero-b branch of c(A,b).
dependency_coverage.meaning: For types α,β,γ with a heterogeneous division operation α×β→γ, extracts that operation.
dependency_coverage.name: Division operation projection

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applies the real set-infimum operation to S(A,b,y). The operation's type alone does not assert attainment.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type α equipped with an InfSet structure, extracts its operation taking a subset of α to its designated infimum value in α.
dependency_coverage.name: Set-infimum operation projection

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the exact zero test in c(A,b); it introduces no floating-point or numerical approximation model.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any two real numbers a,b, supplies a decision of a=b obtained from the real linear-order structure.
dependency_coverage.name: Real equality decision

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the perturbations additive using ordinary real addition.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies ordinary addition of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.name: Real addition instance

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the ordinary real quotient in c(A,b). Its denominator is positive in the branch where b≠0.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equips R with its multiplicative monoid and inverse, division defined by a/b=a·b⁻¹, and recursively defined integer powers, together with the corresponding laws.
dependency_coverage.name: Real division and inverse structure

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines β using the real infimum rather than an extended-real value. Here its feasible set is nonempty and bounded below.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the real set-infimum operation by sInf(S)=−sSup(−S), where −S={−s : s∈S}. For nonempty real sets bounded below, this is the usual greatest lower bound.
dependency_coverage.name: Real infimum instance

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Turns nonnegative sums of squares into the Euclidean and Frobenius norms.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every real x, first convert x to the nonnegative real max(x,0), apply the nonnegative-real square-root map, and return its real value. Thus this is the nonnegative square root for x≥0 and zero for x<0.
dependency_coverage.name: Real square root

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects addition notation in the perturbation predicate to real addition.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type α with addition, provides heterogeneous-addition notation with both inputs and output in α, using the same addition.
dependency_coverage.name: Homogeneous addition adapter

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects division notation in c(A,b) to real division.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type α with division, provides heterogeneous-division notation with both inputs and output in α, using the same division.
dependency_coverage.name: Homogeneous division adapter

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects zero when b=0 and the norm ratio when b≠0.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any result type or sort α, decidable proposition c, and t,e in α, if-then-else returns t when c holds and e when c does not hold.
dependency_coverage.name: Conditional expression

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implements every finite coordinate sum in products, squared norms, and residual objectives.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any index type ι, additive commutative monoid M, finite set s of indices, and f:ι→M, returns Σ_{i∈s} f(i), defined by summing the mapped underlying multiset. An empty sum is zero.
dependency_coverage.name: Finite sum

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures sums range over every coordinate of the relevant finite index type.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any finite type α with a finite enumeration, returns the finite set containing all elements of α.
dependency_coverage.name: Universal finite set

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applies scalar multiplication in matrix-vector and transpose matrix-vector products.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For types α,β,γ with a heterogeneous multiplication operation α×β→γ, extracts that operation.
dependency_coverage.name: Multiplication operation projection

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses the squares of real entries and coordinates.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a base type α, exponent type β, and result type γ with an exponentiation operation, extracts the operation (a,b)↦a^b.
dependency_coverage.name: Exponentiation operation projection

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the exponent 2 in sums of squares by ordinary natural-number powers.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any monoid M, supplies powers x^k for x in M and natural k using the monoid's natural-power operation, with x^0=1 and successive powers given by repeated multiplication.
dependency_coverage.name: Natural powers in a monoid

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the zero and commutative addition needed for finite real sums.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Obtains the additive commutative monoid structure of R from its commutative-ring structure: real addition is associative and commutative with identity zero.
dependency_coverage.name: Real additive commutative monoid

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports real natural powers and the multiplicative structure used by division.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Obtains the multiplicative monoid structure of R from its monoid-with-zero structure: multiplication is associative with identity one.
dependency_coverage.name: Real multiplicative monoid

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the products in A^T b and Ax ordinary real products.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Supplies ordinary multiplication of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.name: Real multiplication instance

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Represents the set of attainable perturbation norms as a predicate on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every type α, a set of elements of α is represented by a predicate α→Prop.
dependency_coverage.name: Sets as predicates

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects multiplication notation in finite products to real multiplication.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type α with multiplication, provides heterogeneous-multiplication notation with both inputs and output in α, using the same multiplication.
dependency_coverage.name: Homogeneous multiplication adapter

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects square notation to natural powers of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For types α and β with powers α×β→α, provides the corresponding heterogeneous exponentiation operation with output in α.
dependency_coverage.name: Exponentiation notation adapter

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the exponent numeral 2 exactly the natural number two.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every natural k, supplies an interpretation of the numeral k in Nat as k itself.
dependency_coverage.name: Natural-number numeral instance

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms S(A,b,y) from the existential feasibility-and-norm predicate.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type α and predicate p:α→Prop, forms the set {x in α : p(x)}; in the predicate representation, this is p itself.
dependency_coverage.name: Set comprehension

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applies subtraction in each residual coordinate.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For types α,β,γ with a heterogeneous subtraction operation α×β→γ, extracts that operation.
dependency_coverage.name: Subtraction operation projection

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the residual coordinate (Ax)_i−b_i ordinary real subtraction.
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines subtraction of real numbers by a−b=a+(−b).
dependency_coverage.name: Real subtraction instance

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects subtraction notation in the residual to real subtraction.
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type α with subtraction, provides heterogeneous-subtraction notation with both inputs and output in α, using the same subtraction.
dependency_coverage.name: Homogeneous subtraction adapter

binders: Universally quantify natural numbers m,n, including zero.
Universally quantify A:Fin m→Fin n→R and b:Fin m→R, identified with A in R^(m×n) and b in R^m.
The existential matrix ΔA in R^(m×n) is chosen after m,n,hmn,A,b and may depend on them.
For that same ΔA, universally quantify every competing matrix E in R^(m×n).
Every least-squares minimization condition universally quantifies its own competitor x in R^n.
conclusions: There exists ΔA in R^(m×n) such that, for every x in R^n, ||b||_2^2≤||(A+ΔA)x−b||_2^2.
For every E in R^(m×n), if for every x in R^n one has ||b||_2^2≤||(A+E)x−b||_2^2, then ||ΔA||_F≤||E||_F.
hypotheses: The only dimension restriction is n≤m.
All entries and coordinates are real.
There is no positivity assumption on either dimension, no rank or invertibility assumption on A, and no nonzero assumption on b.
The solution vector under consideration is fixed to 0 in R^n, and the right-hand-side perturbation is fixed to 0 in R^m.
mathematical_definitions: Fin k={0,…,k−1}; sums over an empty coordinate set are zero.
(Ax)_i=Σ_{j in Fin n} A_ij x_j and (A^T b)_j=Σ_{i in Fin m} A_ij b_i.
Q(A,b,x)=||Ax−b||_2^2. A vector y is a global least-squares minimizer when Q(A,b,y)≤Q(A,b,x) for every x in R^n.
P(A,b,y,ΔA,δb) means that y is a global least-squares minimizer for A+ΔA and b+δb.
S(A,b,y)={η in R : there exists ΔA in R^(m×n) with P(A,b,y,ΔA,0) and η=||ΔA||_F}.
β(A,b,y)=inf S(A,b,y), using the real set-infimum operation.
c(A,b)=0 when b=0, and c(A,b)=||A^T b||_2/||b||_2 when b≠0.

The perturbation model permits arbitrary additive real matrix perturbations, measured by their absolute Frobenius norm, with b unchanged. No computation algorithm, rounding model, tolerance, or relative normalization is specified.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every pair of natural dimensions n≤m, every real m-by-n matrix A, and every real vector b of length m, the infimum of the Frobenius norms of matrix perturbations that make the zero vector a global least-squares minimizer for the perturbed matrix and unchanged right-hand side b equals zero if b=0, and equals ||A^T b||_2/||b||_2 otherwise. Moreover, a perturbation attaining this value exists, and its Frobenius norm is no greater than that of any other perturbation with the same minimization property.

vacuity_risks: For dimensions with n>m the implication has no applicable hypothesis, so the target makes no assertion about them.

Zero dimensions are allowed. If n=0, the solution space has exactly one vector, every least-squares comparison is automatic, and all matrix perturbation norms and the asserted optimum are zero. If m=0, the hypothesis forces n=0.
If b=0, the zero solution is already a least-squares minimizer for every matrix, and ΔA=0 attains the asserted value zero.
Even with b≠0, A^T b may vanish; then zero is already a least-squares minimizer and the asserted optimal norm is zero.

The feasible norm set is never empty: choosing ΔA=−A makes the perturbed objective constant in the solution vector. All feasible norms are nonnegative, so the infimum is a genuine greatest lower bound of a nonempty set bounded below; exceptional conventions for real infima do not affect this target.

The universal comparison is conditional on E being feasible, but feasible competitors exist and the target additionally requires a feasible attaining witness. It is therefore not merely an empty conditional comparison.
The nonzero-b branch has ||b||_2>0; the explicitly defined zero branch avoids any dependence on division-by-zero conventions.
